title: MBCP conformance registry record (v0)
description: One registry entry in docs/registry/: a conformance report for a single implementation against SPEC v0.1. Upgrade path runs self-declaration -> verifier-attested; before any accreditation exists every record is a Conformance Report / Evidence Pack and must carry the honest-framing limitation sentence (enforced by tests/test_registry.py).

version.description: Implementation's own semver (GOVERNANCE principle 3); not the spec version.

producer.description: home = this repository's reference implementation; external = produced by an outside party per CONTRIBUTING.md.

spec_commit.description: Full commit hash the suite numbers were produced against. Auto-filled by tools/make_registry_record.py from git metadata (git rev-parse HEAD); hand-filling is the drift entry point and is banned.

record_generated_at.description: RFC3339 timezone-aware timestamp. Auto-filled by tools/make_registry_record.py from git metadata (git log -1 --format=%cI); never hand-filled.

fail_set.description: Names of failing tests/scenarios at generation time. tools/make_registry_record.py refuses to generate a record unless both suites are fully green, so a committed record must have an empty fail_set; tests/test_registry.py pins that.

kind.description: Upgrade path: a record enters as self-declaration and may be upgraded to verifier-attested after an independent verification session replays the implementation report (see docs/REGISTRY.md).

limitations.description: Required, minItems 1. Must include verbatim: "digest-chain integrity only; third-party-verifiable attestation arrives with L4 signing (roadmap); this record is a Conformance Report, not a legal opinion" — pinned by tests/test_registry.py.

external_benchmark.description: Reserved for future cross-referencing of independent benchmarks. Empty array in v0.1; do not name any real product until an entry is actually accepted.
